before: A run, paragraph-mark or paragraph property write that restates every value rewrote the container in schema order and split the run at the range edges.
after: Such a write returns the part unchanged: no revision, no undo step, and nothing to replicate.
reason: Shared state stores the written tree, not replayed ops. A new writer writes nothing for such a press; an old writer's reordered and split runs still read the same way on every version. The ordered room applies its own changes and receives none for such a press.
